title: Give every action a history.
lead: Follow the connections between objects, materials and the people who know something you do not.
points: The implemented World Graph Phase 1 connects car salvage to conserved materials and graph-defined crafting.
Phase 1 includes a mystery and a four-account Crew operation. The separate Coordination pilots explore independent evidence and deliberate sharing.
Try the browser simulation first. It changes no live inventory and makes each system’s release status explicit.
status: World Graph Phase 1 implemented. Phase 2A in development. Coordination pilots default off. NFT export not live.
cta: Try the material and evidence demo

title: Make your first connection.
lead: Start with a reproducible local API example: recipes, inventory, original discoveries and a completed investigation.
points: Fetch recipe and graph catalogs. Use server-issued actions and content hashes instead of inventing transitions.
The example uses idempotency keys, expected revisions and current sharing permissions. Two fixture accounts contribute separate origins.
The supplied script starts real repository handlers against an in-memory database, asserts results and closes. No production credentials required.
status: Coordination Phases 00–01 are default-off API pilots. The quickstart enables them only in its local process. It is not a hosted onboarding endpoint.

title: Find where your system fits.
lead: Explore concrete integration boundaries across the game world, shared evidence and the proposed canonical market.
points: World Graph Phase 1 supplies implemented material and crafting relationships. Discuss integrations against current APIs and explicit custody rules.
Coordination pilots demonstrate original discoveries and scoped sharing. Later delegation and economic adapters remain planned.
Market V2 proposes fixed fee destinations, finite reserves, inventory bonds, Turf fee rights and liquidity commitments. Treat these as candidate mechanisms.
status: Market V2 is not deployed or funded. No partnership, financial return, launch date or integration commitment is implied.
cta: Review the facts and official links
